title: What's New: Server and Database (2026 release wave 1)

features.name: MCP Protocol Compliance
features.description: The MCP server now supports protocol compliance, allowing use of other MCP clients beyond the default implementation. This enhances interoperability and provides more options for developers.

features.name: File Support Using MCP Resources
features.description: Ability to extract data from Business Central using MCP resources, enabling statistical analysis and data export capabilities for analytics purposes.

features.name: Reduced Memory Footprint Per Tenant
features.description: Memory usage per tenant has been lowered and base64 handling has been optimized to reduce memory pressure from common AL operations, particularly for OData returns.
caveats: Organizations with very large documents may encounter new memory limit errors
Requires code updates to use stream overloads for optimal performance

features.name: Platform Codeunit for Base64 Conversion
features.description: A new platform codeunit has been created for base64 conversion with significantly lower memory footprint than the older implementation. Includes a method to put results into a stream, further reducing memory pressure.
caveats: Existing code does not require changes but may see new out-of-memory exceptions for very large operations
Users must react to new errors and implement limits

features.name: Index Usage Insights and Management
features.description: New capability to get insights into index usage in the database, including how much space is used by indexes and whether they are actually used. Ability to remove unused metadata-defined indexes or auto-tune indexes.
caveats: Removing many indexes can make write operations slower

features.name: AL Analysis View Definitions in Apps
features.description: AL developers can now include analysis view definitions in their apps. Developers use the client to define analysis views, export to JSON, add metadata, and include in the app for availability to users.

features.name: Word Add-in for Document Reports Enhancement
features.description: Updated Word add-in for document reports with improved UI, search functionality in the data picker, and an easy way to define tables for more efficient document report design.

features.name: Layout Lifecycle Control for Report Layouts
features.description: Organizations can now control the lifecycle of any layout in the system through status stages: draft, pending approval, approved, and retired. This prevents uncontrolled layout changes before customer delivery.

features.name: Hardened URI Validation in HTTP Client
features.description: HTTP client URI validation has been hardened to limit outgoing calls from AL code, particularly preventing calls to internal port numbers. Mandatory in hosted environments; optional settings available for on-premises deployments.
caveats: Cannot be opted out of in hosted environments
On-premises deployments have two server settings for control
Backported to version 26 and 27 (wave 1 and wave 2 2025)

features.name: Intra Security Groups for On-Premises Auth
features.description: Ability to use intra security groups for authentication in on-premise scenarios. When enabled via service setting, the system fetches Entra ID security groups on login, enabling permission control based on security groups.
caveats: Requires enabling the service setting enable intra groups on prem

features.name: Permission Analysis Page
features.description: New page for analyzing permissions that provides a permission overview, giving administrators better ability to understand and audit user permissions in the system.

features.name: Updated Security Documentation and Guide
features.description: Comprehensive update to the security guide in documentation incorporating learnings from internal secure development initiative and conference feedback, including a new security scenarios guide showing how security measures affect different environments.

features.name: Telemetry for MCP Configuration and Usage
features.description: New telemetry signals added for MCP configuration changes and MCP usage, allowing administrators to monitor MCP activity in their environments.

features.name: Client Hardware and Network Telemetry
features.description: Page view telemetry now includes client hardware and network speed information, providing better insights into user environment performance characteristics.
